summary: Completed testing of Social Proof and Saved Searches features. All backend APIs (11/11 tests) and frontend UI components working correctly. Social proof strip displays on landing page, testimonials section shows 3 cards with trust badges, SavedSearchModal opens from Dashboard filter bar.

backend: GET /api/social-proof returns all metrics (signups_today, total_users, active_searches, inquiries_today, total_units, total_subscribers)
GET /api/saved-searches returns user's searches when authenticated
POST /api/saved-searches creates new saved search with basic filters
POST /api/saved-searches creates saved search with all filter options (bedrooms, rent range, bathrooms, state, neighborhood)
DELETE /api/saved-searches/{id} deletes search and verifies removal

Landing page shows 3 testimonial cards (Jessica M., David R., Sarah K.)
Trust badges display (All Listings Verified, 38+ Happy Renters, 222+ No-Fee Apartments)

SavedSearchModal opens when clicking Save Search button
Modal shows 'Save Search & Get Alerts' title
Modal has search name input with auto-generated default name
Modal has 'Manage X saved search' link

critical_code_review_comments: Social proof strip conditionally renders based on data (signups_today > 0 || total_users > 50 || active_searches > 0)
